messages:
Nora (CS): Quick weekly check-in on Polaris Labs — hosted spend vs commit. Commit: $50,000/mo. Last 7d usage: $62,300 (~24.6% over). Highlight: 72% of extra spend from /v1/generate (chat) calls. Error rate up from 0.9% → 2.4% last 24h. P99 latency +180ms. Putting flag on anomaly.

Alyssa (CS): ack, can you paste the dashboard link? I want to pull the invoice for renewal discussion :eyes:

Nora (CS): https://console.redwood.ai/consumers/PolarisLabs/usage?range=7d — alert id `anomaly-8932`. Also attaching trigger snapshot:
```
metric: hosted_spend
window: 24h
delta: +24.6%
primary_source: chat_generation
```

billing-bot: Alert triggered: anomaly-8932 — spend spike detected. Estimated overage this month: ~$12.3k. 

Rohit (Billing): @Nora thx. Overage estimation looks right. Polaris has a tiered commit; we'll need to confirm if they hit the soft cap before next billing cycle. I'll queue a proactive invoice note.

Matt (Platform Eng): @Nora @Alyssa quick check — do we see a model variant change? Also any sudden growth in tokens per call? Recommending temporary route to smaller model until we root cause.

Nora (CS): Good catch — yes, we see a drop in avg tokens per response but a 3x increase in requests/min. Might be a burst from a new campaign. Error traces show increased 429s around 16:20 UTC.

Alyssa (CS): Is there an idempotency or retry loop on their side? If retries are aggressive, that could drive both cost and 429s.

Matt (Platform Eng): Pushed a quick routing rule: if latency > 600ms for p99 or error rate > 1.5% then route to model 'redwood-medium-1' as fallback. Also toggled batching to higher threshold for Polaris. Watch dashboards for the next hour.

alerts-bot: Routing rule applied to customer PolarisLabs by Matt (Platform Eng). Rule id: `route-2245-fallback`. 

Nora (CS): Action items — (1) Alyssa to confirm whether Polaris launched a campaign (due EOD). (2) Rohit to prepare overage notice + options (credit vs commit top-up) (3) Matt to monitor routing rule and share perf delta snapshot at +1h. I'll update the renewal risk score if overage persists.

Alyssa (CS): I'll ping their PM now. Thanks. :thumbsup:

Rohit (Billing): Noted. If they accept a commit top-up, we can pro-rate. Sending draft email in #customer-comm later.

Nora (CS): Thanks team. Closing loop in this thread once we have Polaris response. --nora
